posts.title: Red Bull's real call at Baku cost the team the position it was trying to protect
posts.dek: Verstappen passed Hadjar at Turn 1 and never converted it into anything. We reran the stint with the order held instead, corrected for a hold-position call team radio confirms happened, and every team-level number reverses.

posts.title: The only Safety Car case in a decade that punished pace itself
posts.dek: A two-condition test for telling a Safety Car injustice from a bet that didn't pay off, run against ten years of the sport's loudest Safety Car controversies. Only one race clears both bars.

posts.title: VSC costs Norris the win, Pitwall costs Norris the second
posts.dek: Norris led Madrid by 14 seconds, missed the free pit stop under a Virtual Safety Car by one lap, and paid close to the full green-flag price for a stop that should have been nearly free.

posts.title: Nobody qualified on pace
posts.dek: Every clean-air lap in Q3 at Monza trapped the same speed. The grid was strung out by slipstream, not by the cars.
